These vectors carry render_contract annotation metadata.
The C10 verifier render test (synoi-verify/test/source-cursor-render.test.ts)
reads the render_contract block and asserts the rendered HTML matches.
Render label rules (locked English per CLARIFICATIONS.md item 4):
OFAC subject_type: 'Feed snapshot: <source_cursor>'
All other subject_types: 'Feed cursor: <source_cursor>'
Forbidden labels (any of these in rendered HTML = block ship):
'cache cursor'
'cache-cursor citation'
'fresh as of <source_cursor>'
'stale by <x>'
'snapshot freshness'
'Cache cursor'
'Pattern 13 cursor'

'These fields identify which upstream snapshot the gate read.'
'They do not assert freshness; freshness primitive is not yet shipped.'

or 'Feed cache: <source_cursor>'. The render_contract assertion fails with
expected_label_contains mismatch. Removing source_cursor from a valid OFAC entry
and re-running causes the render_contract required_when_source_cursor check to fail.
Spec reference: DEMO_PREWORK_SCHEMAS_2026-06-17.md Section 1.5 + Section 1.6.

name: source_cursor render: ARCH.1 res4 -- verifier output must never contain the word 'independent'
__comment: ARCH.1 resolution (4) per CLARIFICATIONS.md item 4 (second part):
The word 'independent' in verifier-rendered HTML would overclaim that the cited oracle
inputs constitute independent verification of the AI agent's decision. They do not;
they are cited inputs the gate read -- the agent's reasoning is not independently verified.
This vector's render_contract asserts that any subject_type (here: weather) MUST NOT
produce the word 'independent' anywhere in the rendered verifier HTML.
Falsifiability: add 'independently verified by oracle' to the verifier output template.
The forbidden_label_substrings check fires: 'independent' found in rendered output.
The vector fails with the correct reason: overclaim on independence.
This vector is the snapshot test for ARCH.1 res 4 compliance across all subject_types.
The entry below is a minimal valid weather entry (same as valid.json baseline).
The only assertion that matters here is the render_contract.forbidden_label_substrings.

notes: The word 'independent' in any form in the verifier HTML is a ship-blocker.
The cited oracle inputs are gate reads, not independent verifiers.
ARCH.1 res 4: this is the canonical snapshot test for that constraint.
Applies to all subject_types; weather chosen as the simplest baseline entry.
Any verifier template change that introduces 'independent' will fail this vector.
Entry is identical to the baseline weather entry in valid.json.
The unique test coverage here is the render_contract.forbidden_label_substrings['independent'] check.
Without this vector, a template change adding 'independently verified' would be undetected.
